actionConfiguration.body:
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT NULLIF(setting_value, '')::uuid AS branch_id
    FROM system_settings
    WHERE setting_key = 'default_branch_id'
)
SELECT b.id AS value, b.name AS label
FROM branches b
WHERE b.is_active = true
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN b.id = (SELECT branch_id FROM cfg) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    b.created_at ASC
LIMIT 1;
